name: Master Caution
tagline: The flight console with one amber light: a master caution band says what waits on an admin, the flight plan is drawn into the weeks still to fly, and every tube switches on with a roll of light.
concept: Flight Console with one amber light. Master Caution keeps Lamps and Ladders' instruments (the jewelled pilot lamps, the moving-coil meter, the radar tube, the violet flight plan) and replaces its weakest parts with three grafts rebuilt in the console's terms: a master caution band, the same component on Home, Status and Settings, that says in one 64px line what waits on an admin, its amber lamp lit from behind in a sunk window; the Plans month with its flown weeks folded (a run of empty ones to a single strip that says so) and the flight plan drawn into a line of legs over each week still to fly, the leg rows carrying the same columns as the week under them; and a bar of light that rolls once down every tube as it switches on, a tenth of a second after the page. A lit phosphor bus runs through the models that answer on Status. The ladders are gone, every count is said once in plain tabular figures, the only lit figure on a rail is the day's clock, and 'here' is one latched dark key with its jewel lamp on every control that latches.
companions: Slate (#111716) for every bay under one 2px top rule; the latched dark key (surface-3, a 2px steel cap #a9c4d8 and the jewel lamp) for 'here' and 'this one' everywhere: the bar, the filters, the settings nav, and today's numeral on the month; steel (#6f8596) for the log's wire and the family's stops and a faint wash down today's column; pewter for off, for flown days and the folded strip; violet (#a191bd, flown #6d6280) only for the flight plan's lines, rings and leg lengths; amber (#e3a651, its own --caution token) only for the master caution's lamp, edge and figure, and for late (words, bar lamp, a row's edge); clay (#bf8a6a) for the restaurant swatch and its icon, with the seasonal swatch moved to mulberry (#c86f96) to stay apart from it.
